title: TexaGlobal Technologies: A Website Design and Development Case Study for a CCTV and Networking Products Company in Kochi
storyLead: How Teknoppy designed a brand-led B2B website for a Kochi electronic security company, helping dealers, installers and businesses across Kerala find the right CCTV camera, cable or PoE switch, compare brands and request a quote in a few clicks.
atAGlance: TexaGlobal supplies CCTV cameras, accessories, cables, PoE switches, network products and IT peripherals from its head office in Kochi
The CCTV company website has two ways in: browse by product type or browse by brand
Five brands, PRIZOR, SPARSH, AXIVO, FYBER and GTX, each get a clear place in the navigation
Certified products are highlighted on the homepage to build trust with professional buyers
"Request a quote", "Contact Now" and WhatsApp turn product interest into dealer and project enquiries
aboutParagraphs: TexaGlobal Technologies is an electronic security and networking company headquartered at Elamkulam Junction, on Chilavannoor Road in Kochi, near Metro Pillar 813. It also operates a branch office in Jamnagar, Gujarat, and describes itself as a manufacturer, distributor and complete solution provider.

Its range covers CCTV cameras and DVRs, CCTV accessories, CCTV SMPS power supplies, CAT6 and CCTV cables, managed and unmanaged PoE switches, routers and network adapters, and IT peripherals. Products are sold under five brands: PRIZOR, SPARSH, AXIVO, FYBER and GTX.

TexaGlobal highlights BIS-ER (STQC) certified CCTV cameras, including what it presents as India's first STQC-certified Sparsh CCTV camera. It works with CCTV dealers, installers and system integrators. Teknoppy was brought in to design and build a website that presents this range clearly to professional buyers in Kochi, across Kerala and beyond.
challengeLead: Five problems shaped the design brief.

challenges.title: A wide, technical catalogue
challenges.description: Cameras, cables, switches, power supplies and peripherals all have different buyers and specifications. The site needed order, not a long list.

challenges.title: Five brands under one company
challenges.description: Dealers often search by brand name. Each brand needed its own path without confusing the parent company's identity.

challenges.title: Trust in a crowded CCTV market
challenges.description: Kerala's CCTV market has many competing brands and unbranded imports. Certified, branded equipment needed to stand out at first glance.

challenges.title: B2B buyers want prices and stock fast
challenges.description: Installers and dealers usually want to ask for a quote or check availability before they order.

challenges.title: Two locations, one brand
challenges.description: The site had to present a Kochi head office and a Gujarat branch without splitting the brand.

objectiveLead: The goal was a professional electronics distributor website that helps Kerala dealers and businesses find TexaGlobal products and send enquiries.
objectives: Organise the full catalogue into clear product categories
Give each of the five brands its own browsing path
Put certified products and trust signals on the homepage
Make quote requests and WhatsApp contact one click away
Show the Kochi head office clearly for local buyers
approachLead: Six decisions built around how dealers and installers buy.

approachPillars.title: Two ways to browse: product or brand
paragraphs: The main menu offers Products (CCTV Cameras, CCTV Accessories, Cables, PoE Switches and Network Products) and a separate "Browse by Brands" menu. A dealer who knows the brand and an installer who knows the product type both reach the right page fast.

approachPillars.title: Certified products up front
paragraphs: The homepage opens with BIS-ER (STQC) certified CCTV cameras and the Sparsh certification story, giving professional buyers an immediate reason to trust the range.

approachPillars.title: Clear positioning in one line
paragraphs: A "Manufacturer, Distributor, Complete Solution Provider" banner and a dedicated CCTV SMPS section explain what TexaGlobal does and where it is strongest.

approachPillars.title: Enquiry paths built for B2B
paragraphs: "Request a quote" and "Contact Now" buttons appear across the site, with a WhatsApp chat link for quick questions about stock, pricing and project requirements.

approachPillars.title: Local trust for Kochi buyers
paragraphs: The full Elamkulam address, with the nearby metro pillar landmark, phone numbers and email appear in the footer, so Kochi customers know exactly where to find the team.

approachPillars.title: A flexible WordPress build
paragraphs: Built on WordPress with Elementor, the site lets TexaGlobal's team add new products, brands and certifications without a developer, and keeps a newsletter sign-up to stay in touch with dealers.

deliverables.title: Product and brand navigation
deliverables.description: Five product categories and five brand menus.

deliverables.title: Trust-led homepage
deliverables.description: Certified CCTV cameras, positioning and SMPS highlights.

deliverables.title: B2B enquiry flow
deliverables.description: Quote requests, contact forms, WhatsApp and newsletter.

deliverables.title: Responsive WordPress website
deliverables.description: Easy to update, clean on desktop and mobile.

whyMattersHeading: Why brand-led website design wins CCTV dealers in Kerala
whyMattersParagraphs: For a security systems company in Kerala, the market is dealer-driven. Installers and system integrators choose which brands to stock, and they compare suppliers on certification, range, price and support. A multi-brand website that lets them browse by brand, check certified products and ask for a quote in one click becomes part of their daily workflow.

Certification is a strong selling point. Buyers are careful about the cameras they install in homes, offices and public spaces, and certified equipment answers that concern directly. Putting it on the homepage, rather than in a brochure, turns compliance into a competitive advantage.

Being clearly local also counts. Many Kochi dealers prefer suppliers they can visit, call and collect from. A visible Elamkulam address, with a landmark buyers recognise, makes TexaGlobal feel close and dependable, while the Gujarat branch shows reach beyond Kerala.
whyMattersCalloutHtml:
For a B2B electronics brand, the website should work like a good sales rep: know the range, prove the quality and make the next step easy.
